objective: Discover a data-efficient surrogate architecture for the 61-state four-compartment micro-Hay system while learning which abstract properties of the causal dynamics are supported by controlled experiments.

current_teacher.name: micro-Hay four-compartment teacher
current_teacher.inputs: 24 binary presynaptic event channels packed over five 0.1 ms microsteps
current_teacher.test_policy: closed until one candidate, seeds and decision rule are locked

global_stop_rules: Close a branch after two consecutive experiments reproduce the same falsifying signature without adding a new causal distinction.
Do not scale width, depth, epochs or dataset size before the proposed inductive bias passes a capacity-matched preflight.
Do not change more than one primary causal factor unless the experiment is an explicitly preregistered factorial interaction test.
Do not open the test split during discovery.
Do not promote a result explained only by more parameters, optimizer updates or privileged teacher information.
Do not run an experiment that cannot name the knowledge-ledger entry it may update.

creative_discovery_policy.sketches_per_cycle: 10-20 structurally distinct small candidates before narrowing
creative_discovery_policy.hits_per_cycle: 2-3 survivors selected by capability profile and guardrails
creative_discovery_policy.required_search_mode_diversity: At least two of rational, analogical, phenotypic, fragment-based or constrained de-novo when the hypothesis permits.
creative_discovery_policy.mandatory_deconvolution: A hit cannot enter lead optimization until probes or interventions identify a plausible used mechanism.
creative_discovery_policy.synthetic_to_real_gate: A microtask result authorizes only a controlled full-teacher preflight.
creative_discovery_policy.composition_gate: Every component must name an independent capability result and a monolithic capacity-matched control.

source_refresh_policy.rule: The 15 original sources remain authoritative and must be reread in full; the derived documentation is only a compact operational view.
mandatory_triggers: entry into a new program phase
start of a creative architecture sketch cycle

promotion_ladder.requirement: read-only checkpoint analysis or synthetic capability probe
signature-specific improvement and all guardrails on validation
median improvement across at least three seeds with uncertainty reported
candidate, seed protocol and thresholds frozen before one test evaluation

phases.name: Integrity and governance
phases.purpose: Make every result causal, reproducible and auditable.
deliverables: frozen data contract and runtime SHA-256
exit_criteria: every active experiment has a preregistration

phases.name: Baseline observatory
phases.purpose: Separate output failure, representation failure and optimization failure before changing a model.
exit_criteria: next causal axis selected without using test

phases.name: Capability bench
phases.purpose: Test established layers on isolated algorithmic capabilities before full-teacher training.
deliverables: internal probes for each selected hit
exit_criteria: each scaffold has a capability signature
architectures that fail their required microtask are pruned

phases.name: Objective and exposure
phases.purpose: Determine whether rare-transition collapse is caused by target imbalance, loss geometry or rollout mismatch.
exit_criteria: at least one objective retained or objective branch closed

phases.name: Scaffold screen
phases.purpose: Compare established causal operators under matched capacity and training.
deliverables: learning curves and capability profiles rather than a final-score-only table
exit_criteria: each rejected scaffold has a scoped falsification claim

phases.name: Spatial and regime composition
phases.purpose: Test whether four-compartment coupling and rare transitions benefit from standard modular structure.
entry_criteria: evidence of separable spatial or regime structure
exit_criteria: only modules with independent evidence remain
composition gain exceeds monolithic capacity control

phases.name: Conditional interventions
phases.purpose: Change activation, normalization, optimizer or regularization only when a measured indicator predicts a specific signature.

phases.name: Evidence-guided synthesis
phases.purpose: Compose only modules that have independently demonstrated required capabilities.
entry_criteria: at least two promoted and complementary mechanisms
exit_criteria: composition provides non-additive gain without guardrail failure

phases.name: Replication, efficiency and confirmation
phases.purpose: Turn a discovery result into a bounded confirmatory claim.
